visual_elements.description: Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.0. Headers: 'Predicted as' above columns P and N. Row header 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells: P row: 5 (red), 0 (black); N row: 6 (black), 0 (red). To the right: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'.

Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.1. Headers: 'Predicted as' above columns P and N. Row header 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells: P row: 5 (red), 0 (black); N row: 4 (black), 2 (red). To the right: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'.

Confusion matrix for Threshold=0.3. Headers: 'Predicted as' above columns P and N. Row header 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells: P row: 5 (red), 0 (black); N row: 2 (black), 4 (red). To the right: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33'.

ROC curve plot. Y-axis labeled 'TPR' (vertical text). X-axis labeled 'FPR' (horizontal text). Light blue plot area with grid. Three data points marked with red circles, labeled above with '0.3' (left), '0.1' (center), '0.0' (right). Blue border around plot area. Mouse cursor arrow visible near the 0.3 point.
Text box containing two equations: 'TPR = TP / TP + FN' and 'FPR = FP / FP + TN'. Red border.
Small confusion matrix legend. Headers: 'Predicted as' above columns P and N. Row header 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells: P,P = TP (red); P,N = FN (black); N,P = FP (black); N,N = TN (green).

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Panel headers like 'Threshold=0.0' are bold. Axis labels 'TPR' and 'FPR' are rotated/vertical. Matrix values are colored: correct classifications (TP, TN) in red, errors in black, with TN also shown in green in the legend matrix. Slide number '31' is black text inside a yellow circle.
animation_state: None apparent; all elements appear static.
recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Add slide number '31' in a yellow circle at the top-right corner.
3. Create left column with three stacked red-bordered panels.
4. Panel 1: Add header 'Threshold=0.0'. Insert 2x2 table with header 'Predicted as', columns P/N, row header 'Actual', rows P/N. Fill cells: P row [5, 0], N row [6, 0]. Color 5 and bottom-right 0 in red; 6 and top-right 0 in black. Add text to right: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=6/(6+0)=1'.
5. Panel 2: Same structure with header 'Threshold=0.1'. Cells: P row [5, 0], N row [4, 2]. Color 5 and bottom-right 2 in red; 4 and top-right 0 in black. Add text: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'.
6. Panel 3: Same structure with header 'Threshold=0.3'. Cells: P row [5, 0], N row [2, 4]. Color 5 and bottom-right 4 in red; 2 and top-right 0 in black. Add text: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1' and 'FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33'.
7. Add vertical blue divider line between left column and center/right.
8. Add center-bottom box with text 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'.
9. Create right-side blue-bordered graph area. Add Y-axis label 'TPR' (vertical), X-axis label 'FPR'. Add light blue grid background. Plot three points with red circles labeled above: '0.3' at left, '0.1' at center, '0.0' at right.
10. Add bottom-right formula panel with red border containing: 'TPR = TP / TP + FN' and 'FPR = FP / FP + TN'.
11. Add small confusion matrix to the right of formulas: headers 'Predicted as' (P, N), row header 'Actual' (P, N). Cells: TP (red), FN (black), FP (black), TN (green).
